units.zh: 在位四年，奏尚書張林阿附侍中竇憲，而素行臧穢，又上洛陽令楊光，憲之賓客，在官貪殘，並不宜處位。
units.en: After four years in office he memorialized that Master of Writing Zhang Lin fawned on Dou Xian yet was corrupt by nature, and that Luoyang magistrate Yang Guang, a client of Dou Xian, was greedy and cruel in office—neither should hold rank.
units.literal: In office four years he memorialized that Master of Writing Zhang Lin fawned on attendant-in-ordinary Dou Xian yet his conduct was corrupt; he also reported Luoyang magistrate Yang Guang, a guest of Xian's, greedy and cruel in office—none were fit to hold position.

units.zh: 光報憲，憲奏弘大臣漏洩密事。
units.en: Yang Guang reported to Dou Xian, and Dou memorialized that Zheng Hong had leaked state secrets.
units.literal: Guang reported to Xian; Xian memorialized that Hong, a great minister, had leaked secret affairs.

units.zh: 帝詰讓弘，收上印綬。
units.en: The emperor rebuked Zheng Hong and took back his seal and cord.
units.literal: The emperor rebuked Hong and collected his seal and cord.

units.zh: 弘自詣廷尉，詔敕出之，因乞骸骨歸，未許。
units.en: Zheng Hong went to the commandant of justice himself; an edict ordered his release, but when he asked to retire he was not permitted.
units.literal: Hong himself went to the commandant of justice; an edict ordered his release; he then begged to return his bones home, but was not granted it.

units.zh: 病篤，上書陳謝，並言竇憲之短。
units.en: Gravely ill, he submitted a memorial of thanks and also reported Dou Xian's faults.
units.literal: Gravely ill, he submitted a memorial expressing thanks and also stating Dou Xian's faults.

units.zh: 帝省章，遣醫占弘病，比至已卒。
units.en: The emperor read the memorial and sent a physician to examine him; by the time the doctor arrived Zheng Hong was already dead.
units.literal: The emperor read the memorial and sent a physician to examine Hong's illness; by the time he arrived Hong had already died.

units.zh: 臨歿悉還賜物，敕妻子褐巾布衣素棺殯殮，以還鄉里。
units.en: On his deathbed he returned all imperial gifts and ordered his wife and children to bury him in plain cloth and a plain coffin, then return home.
units.literal: At death he returned all granted goods; he ordered his wife and children to wear brown headcloths and plain clothes and a plain coffin for burial, then return to their home district.

units.zh: 周章字次叔，南陽隨人也。
units.en: Zhou Zhang, styled Cishu, came from Sui in Nanyang commandery.
units.literal: Zhou Zhang, courtesy name Cishu, was a man of Sui in Nanyang.

units.zh: 初仕郡為功曹。
units.en: He first served the commandery as merit assessor.
units.literal: At first he served the commandery as merit assessor.

units.zh: 時大將軍竇憲免，封冠軍侯就國。
units.en: When Grand General Dou Xian was dismissed and enfeoffed as Marquis of Guanjun, he returned to his fief.
units.literal: At that time Grand General Dou Xian was dismissed and enfeoffed as Marquis of Guanjun, returning to his state.

units.zh: 章從太守行春到冠軍，太守猶欲謁之。
units.en: Zhou Zhang accompanied the governor on a spring inspection tour to Guanjun; the governor still meant to call on Dou Xian.
units.literal: Zhang followed the governor on the spring circuit to Guanjun; the governor still wished to call on Xian.

units.zh: 章進諫曰：『今日公行春，豈可越儀私交。
units.en: Zhou Zhang remonstrated: "Today you are on the spring circuit—how can you overstep protocol for a private visit?
units.literal: Zhang advanced remonstrance saying: "Today Your Excellency is on the spring circuit—how can you overstep ritual for a private visit?

units.zh: 且憲椒房之親，勢傾王室，而退就藩國，禍福難量。
units.en: Moreover Dou Xian is empress kin whose power once tilted the throne; now he withdraws to his fief—fortune and disaster are hard to measure.
units.literal: Moreover Xian is kin of the empress's chamber; his power once tilted the royal house; now he withdraws to his feudal state—fortune and disaster are hard to measure.

units.zh: 明府剖符大臣，千里重任，舉止進退，其可輕乎？』
units.en: You are a minister bearing the imperial tally, charged with a thousand li—can your comings and goings be treated lightly?"
units.literal: Your Excellency is a minister bearing the split tally, charged with a thousand li—can your comings and goings be treated lightly?"

units.zh: 太守不聽，遂便升車。
units.en: The governor would not listen and mounted his carriage.
units.literal: The governor would not listen and then mounted his carriage.

units.zh: 章前拔佩刀絕馬鞅，於是乃止。
units.en: Zhou Zhang stepped forward, drew his sword, and cut the horse's traces—only then did the governor stop.
units.literal: Zhang stepped forward, drew his girdle sword, and cut the horse's traces; only then did he stop.

units.zh: 及憲被誅，公卿以下多以交關得罪，太守幸免，以此重章。
units.en: When Dou Xian was executed, grandees and officials were punished for association; the governor escaped by luck and thereafter held Zhou Zhang in high esteem.
units.literal: When Xian was executed, grandees and officials below mostly were punished for association; the governor escaped by luck, and for this held Zhang in high esteem.

units.zh: 舉孝廉，六遷為五官中郎將。
units.en: Nominated filial and incorrupt, he rose through six promotions to colonel of the Five Offices.
units.literal: Raised filial and incorrupt, through six transfers he became colonel of the Five Offices.

units.zh: 延平元年，為光祿勳。
units.en: In Yanping 1 he became Minister of the Imperial Household.
units.literal: In the first year of Yanping he became Minister of the Imperial Household.

units.zh: 永初元年，代魏霸為太常。
units.en: In Yongchu 1 he succeeded Wei Ba as Minister of Ceremonies.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongchu he replaced Wei Ba as Minister of Ceremonies.

units.zh: 其冬，代尹勤為司空。
units.en: That winter he succeeded Yin Qin as Minister of Works.
units.literal: That winter he replaced Yin Qin as Minister of Works.

units.zh: 是時中常侍鄭眾，蔡倫等皆秉勢豫政，章數進直言。
units.en: Palace attendants Zheng Zhong, Cai Lun, and others then held power in government; Zhou Zhang repeatedly offered blunt counsel.
units.literal: At this time the palace attendants Zheng Zhong, Cai Lun, and others all held power and took part in government; Zhang repeatedly advanced blunt counsel.

units.zh: 初，和帝崩，鄧太后以皇子勝有痼疾，不可奉承宗廟，貪殤帝孩抱，養為己子，故立之，以勝為平原王。
units.en: When Emperor He died, Empress Dowager Deng held that Prince Sheng had a chronic illness and could not attend the ancestral temple; she seized the infant Emperor Shang, raised him as her own, enthroned him, and made Sheng King of Pingyuan.
units.literal: At first, when Emperor He died, Empress Dowager Deng held that the prince Sheng had chronic illness and could not attend the ancestral temple; coveting the infant Emperor Shang in her arms, she raised him as her own son and therefore enthroned him, making Sheng King of Pingyuan.

units.zh: 及殤帝崩，群臣以勝疾非痼、意咸歸之，太后以前既不立，恐後為怨，乃立和帝兄清河孝王子祐，是為安帝。
units.en: When Emperor Shang died, ministers held that Sheng's illness was not chronic and hearts turned to him; fearing later resentment for not having enthroned him earlier, the empress dowager enthroned Liu You, son of King Xiao of Qinghe and brother of Emperor He—Emperor An.
units.literal: When Emperor Shang died, the host of ministers held that Sheng's illness was not chronic and their hearts all turned to him; the empress dowager, because she had not enthroned him before, feared later resentment, and therefore enthroned You, son of King Xiao of Qinghe, brother of Emperor He—this was Emperor An.

units.zh: 章以眾心不附，遂密謀閉宮門，誅車騎將軍鄧騭兄弟及鄭眾、蔡倫，劫尚書，廢太后於南宮，封帝為遠國王，而立平原王勝。
units.en: Zhou Zhang, finding popular hearts unattached, secretly plotted to shut the palace gates, execute Deng Zhi and his brothers along with Zheng Zhong and Cai Lun, seize the Masters of Writing, depose the empress dowager in the Southern Palace, banish the emperor to a distant kingdom, and enthrone Prince Sheng of Pingyuan.
units.literal: Zhang, because popular hearts did not attach, then secretly plotted to shut the palace gates, execute Chariots-and-Cavalry General Deng Zhi and his brothers along with Zheng Zhong and Cai Lun, seize the Masters of Writing, depose the empress dowager in the Southern Palace, enfeoff the emperor as king of a distant state, and enthrone King of Pingyuan Sheng.

units.zh: 事覺，策免，章自殺。
units.en: The plot was discovered; he was dismissed by edict and killed himself.
units.literal: The plot was discovered; he was dismissed by edict; Zhang killed himself.

units.zh: 家無餘財，諸子易衣而出，並日而食。
units.en: The household had no surplus wealth; his sons exchanged clothes to go out and ate on alternate days.
units.literal: The household had no surplus wealth; his sons exchanged clothes to go out and ate on alternate days.

units.zh: 論曰：孔子稱『可與立，未可與權』。
units.en: The historian remarks: Confucius said, 'You can stand firm with some men—not weigh shifting circumstances with every one.'
units.literal: The appraisal says: Confucius called 'May stand with him, not yet may weigh circumstances with him.'

units.zh: 權也者，反常者也。
units.en: Expediency means departing from the usual rule.
units.literal: Weighing circumstances is departing from the norm.

units.zh: 將從反常之事，必資非常之會，使夫舉無違妄，誌行名全。
units.en: Acting outside the norm calls for extraordinary timing—only then can the deed avoid folly and leave ambition, deed, and reputation intact.
units.literal: About to follow abnormal affairs, must rely on extraordinary conjunctions, causing those undertakings without violation or recklessness, aspiration and conduct name preserved whole.

units.zh: 周章身非負圖之托，德乏萬夫之望，主無絕天之釁，
units.en: Zhou Zhang bore no Duke-of-Zhou mandate; he lacked popular esteem; the emperor gave Heaven no cause for revolt,
units.literal: Zhou Zhang bore no regent's charge like the Duke of Zhou; virtue fell short of the multitude's hopes; the ruler showed no crime against Heaven's mandate,

units.zh: 地有既安之埶，而創慮於難圖，希功於理絕，不已悖乎！
units.en: the realm already rested secure—yet he plotted the impossible and hoped for success where cause was dead—was that not folly?
units.literal: earth had already settled posture, yet he devised schemes on hard-to-plan matters, hoped achievement where principle was cut off—is it not already perverse!

units.zh: 如令君器易以下議，即鬥筲必能叨天業，狂夫豎臣亦自奮矣。
units.en: If high office bends to petty counsel, every small talent will grasp at the Mandate and cranks will rush forward.
units.literal: If high office yields easily to counsel from below, then petty measure could seize heaven's enterprise; madmen and petty ministers too would exert themselves.

units.zh: 孟軻有言曰：『有伊尹之心則可，無伊尹之心則篡矣。』
units.en: Mencius said, 'With Yi Yin's intent it is permissible; without it, it is usurpation.'
units.literal: Meng Ke had words saying: 'Having Yi Yin's heart then acceptable; lacking Yi Yin's heart then usurpation.'

units.zh: 於戲，方來之人戒之哉！
units.en: Alas—let those who come after take warning!
units.literal: Alas, those who come after—guard against it!

units.zh: 贊曰：朱定北州，激成寵尤。
units.en: Verse says: Zhu Fu steadied Youzhou but baited Peng Chong into rebellion.
units.literal: The encomium says: Zhu settled northern province; incited completion Chong's fault.

units.zh: 魴用降帑，延感歸囚。
units.en: Feng Fang drew grain from the treasury to win surrender; Yu Yan's grace sent prisoners home on time.
units.literal: Fang used surrendering treasury; Yan moved returning prisoners.

units.zh: 鄭、竇怨偶，代相為仇，周章反道，小智大謀。
units.en: Zheng Hong and the Dou clan were paired in strife; generation after generation turned hostile; Zhou Zhang defied the Way—petty wit, vaulting plot.
units.literal: Zheng, Dou paired enmity; generation succeeding became foes; Zhou Zhang opposed the Way; small wisdom great plotting.

units.zh: 放子 純
units.en: Zhang Fang's son: Zhang Chun.
units.literal: Fang's son: Chun.

units.zh: 公孫弘以宰相，布被，食不重味，為下先，然而無益於俗，稍務於功利矣。
units.en: Even under Gongsun Hong's austere personal style, court policy kept drifting toward utilitarian gain.
units.literal: With Gongsun Hong as chancellor, though he wore plain cloth and ate simply as example, he did not improve social custom; policy increasingly turned to utility and profit.

units.zh: 自孫弘以春秋之義繩臣下取漢相，張湯以峻文決理為廷尉，於是見知之法生，而廢格沮誹窮治之獄用矣。
units.en: Moralist and legalist techniques fused into a harsher prosecutorial regime, including broad guilt-by-knowledge doctrines.
units.literal: From Sun Hong using Spring and Autumn standards to bind ministers and become Han chancellor, and Zhang Tang using severe textual law as chief justice, then laws of 'seen and known' arose, and prosecutions for obstruction, disparagement, and exhaustive investigation were used.

units.zh: 頃之，代朱浮為大司空。
units.en: Soon after he replaced Zhu Fu as grand minister of works.
units.literal: Before long, he replaced Zhu Fu as Grand Minister of Works.

units.zh: 二十二年，復為光祿勛。
units.en: In the twenty-second year he was again appointed bearer of the brightness.
units.literal: In the twenty-second year, he again became Bearer of the Brightness.

units.zh: 常欲訪山東而尋子雲，問關西而求伯起，遇有今信，力附相聞，遲比來郵，慰其延佇。」
units.en: I had long wished to search Shandong for Zhong Jun and inquire west of the Pass for Yang Zhen. Now that a messenger has arrived, I have urgently entrusted him with this word. I await the next courier to ease my long suspense."
units.literal: I had long wished to search Shandong for Ziyun and inquire west of the Pass for Boqi. Now that a messenger has arrived, I have urgently entrusted him with this word. I await the next courier to console my protracted waiting."

units.zh: 是时和帝与中常侍郑众谋夺窦氏权，德之，因任用之，及幸常侍蔡伦，二人始并用权。
units.en: He had conspired with Zheng Zhong to break the Dous, then raised Zhong and Cai Lun until both eunuchs shared the inner court's power.
units.literal: At that time Emperor He with Regular Attendant Zheng Zhong plotted to seize the Dou clan's power; he valued Zhong and therefore employed him, and when he favored Regular Attendant Cai Lun, the two began together to wield power.

units.zh: 七年九月癸卯，京都地震。
units.en: Yongyuan 7 (95 CE), ninth month, guimao: Luoyang trembled.
units.literal: On the day guimao in the ninth month of the seventh year the capital suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 明年，坐考隴西太守鄧融事無所據，策免。
units.en: The next year he lost his post for pressing a case against Deng Rong, grand administrator of Longxi, without evidence.
units.literal: The next year, for sitting in judgment on the affair of grand administrator Deng Rong of Longxi without basis, he was dismissed by rescript.

units.zh: 向徙封東武陽侯，卒，子述嗣，永平十五年，坐與楚王英謀反，國除。
units.en: Liu Xiang's fief shifted to Dongwuyang; when he died, his son Liu Shu succeeded, and in Yongping 15 Shu lost the title for plotting with Prince Ying of Chu.
units.literal: Xiang was moved in fief to marquis of Dongwuyang; when he died, his son Shu succeeded; in the fifteenth year of Yongping, because he sat in conspiracy with the Prince of Chu Ying to rebel, the state was abolished.

units.zh: 王郎起，植與弟喜、從兄歆率宗族賓客，聚兵數千人據昌城。
units.en: When Wang Lang rebelled, Liu Zhi, his brother Liu Xi, and cousin Liu Xin rallied clan and clients, several thousand strong, and held Changcheng.
units.literal: When Wang Lang rose, Zhi with his younger brother Xi and elder cousin Xin led lineage and retainers, gathered several thousand troops, and occupied Changcheng.

units.zh: 對曰：「數尋伊、霍之傳，不讀曹、馬之書。」
units.en: He replied, "I pore over the lives of Yi Yin and Huo Guang — not the chronicles of Cao Cao and the Sima clan."
units.literal: He replied: "I often seek the biographies of Yi Yin and Huo Guang; I do not read the books of Cao [Cao] and the Sima [clan]."

units.zh: 元坦 元斌 元孝友 元暉業 元弼 元韶
units.en: Yuan Tan; Yuan Bin; Yuan Xiaoyou; Yuan Huiye; Yuan Bi; Yuan Shao
units.literal: Yuan Tan; Yuan Bin; Yuan Xiaoyou; Yuan Huiye; Yuan Bi; Yuan Shao

units.zh: 魏霸字喬卿，濟陰句陽人也。
units.en: Wei Ba, styled Qiaoqing, came from Gouyang in Jiyin commandery.
units.literal: Wei Ba, courtesy name Qiaoqing, was a man of Gouyang in Jiyin.

units.zh: 霸少喪親，兄弟同居，州裏慕其雍和。
units.en: Orphaned young, he lived with his brothers in harmony that the whole district admired.
units.literal: Ba young lost parents; brothers dwelt together; the province admired their harmony.

units.zh: 建初中，舉孝廉，八遷，和帝時為巨鹿太守。
units.en: Recommended as Filial and Incorrupt during Jianchu, he rose through eight posts to grand administrator of Julu under Emperor He.
units.literal: In mid Jianchu he was recommended Filial and Incorrupt; eight promotions; under Emperor He he became grand administrator of Julu.

units.zh: 永元十六年，征拜將作大匠。
units.en: In Yongyuan 16 he was summoned to serve as Superintendent of Imperial Works.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year of Yongyuan he was summoned and appointed Superintendent of Construction.

units.zh: 延平元年，代尹勤為太常。
units.en: In Yanping 1 he succeeded Yin Qin as Grand Master of Ceremonies.
units.literal: In the first year of Yanping he replaced Yin Qin as Grand Master of Ceremonies.

units.zh: 以簡樸寬恕為政。
units.en: He governed with plain honesty and lenience.
units.literal: He took simplicity and forgiveness as governance.

units.zh: 掾史有過，霸先誨其失，不改者乃罷之。
units.en: When subordinates slipped, he corrected them first and dismissed only those who refused to mend their ways.
units.literal: When clerks erred, Ba first instructed them in their faults; those who did not reform—only then did he dismiss them.

units.zh: 吏或相毀訴，霸輒稱它吏之長，終不及人短，言者懷慚，譖訟遂息。
units.en: When officials denounced one another, Ba praised each man's strengths and ignored faults until the accusers grew ashamed and dropped their suits.
units.literal: When officials sometimes mutually slandered and sued, Ba always praised other clerks' strengths and never reached others' shortcomings; those who spoke felt shame; slander lawsuits then ceased.

units.zh: 明年，和帝崩，典作順陵。
units.en: The following year Emperor He died; Wei supervised construction of the Shun Mausoleum.
units.literal: The next year Emperor He died; he supervised construction of the Shun Mausoleum.

units.zh: 霸撫循而已，初不切責，而反勞之曰：『令諸卿被辱，大匠過也。』
units.en: Wei soothed his men instead of rebuking them: "If you were humiliated, the fault is mine as superintendent."
units.literal: Ba comforted and followed them only; at first he did not sharply blame; instead he consoled them, saying, "Having caused you gentlemen to suffer insult—is the Superintendent's fault."

units.zh: 時盛冬地凍，中使督促，數罰縣吏以厲霸。
units.en: Deep winter froze the ground; eunuch overseers drove the work and punished county clerks repeatedly to pressure Wei.
units.literal: At that time deep winter froze the earth; palace envoys urged supervision; repeatedly they punished county clerks to sharpen Ba.

units.zh: 吏皆懷恩，力作倍功。
units.en: Grateful, the crews doubled their efforts.
units.literal: The clerks all cherished grace; exerted labor twofold in accomplishment.

units.zh: 明年，以病致仕，為光祿大夫。
units.en: The following year he retired on grounds of illness and became Household Counselor.
units.literal: The next year, on account of illness he retired from office and became Household Counselor.

units.zh: 永初五年，拜長樂衛尉，以病乞身，復為光祿大夫，卒於官。
units.en: In Yongchu 5 he was appointed Commandant of Changle, then begged leave on grounds of illness, returned to Household Counselor, and died in that post.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Yongchu he was appointed Commandant of Changle; on account of illness he begged to withdraw; again he became Household Counselor and died in office.

units.zh: 寬、霸臨政，亦稱優緩。
units.en: Liu Kuan and Wei Ba governed with the same gentle forbearance.
units.literal: Kuan and Ba facing governance likewise were called lenient and slow.

units.zh: 時民近戰國，皆背本趨末，賈誼說上曰：筦子曰「倉廩實而知禮節」。
units.en: At the time popular life resembled the Warring States era, with everyone abandoning farming for marginal trades. Jia Yi urged the emperor, saying: Guanzi says, "When granaries are full, the people know ritual propriety."
units.literal: At the time the people were close to Warring States conditions, all turning from the fundamental to the marginal. Jia Yi persuaded the emperor, saying: Guanzi says, "When granaries are full, the people know ritual propriety."

units.zh: 於是上感誼言，始開籍田，躬耕以勸百姓。
units.en: Thereupon the emperor was moved by Jia Yi's words, first opened the imperial plow-fields, and personally plowed to encourage the people.
units.literal: Thereupon the emperor was moved by Jia Yi's words, first opened imperial fields and personally plowed to encourage the people.

units.zh: 漢之為漢幾四十年矣，公私之積猶可哀痛。
units.en: Even after decades, both state and household reserves remained fragile.
units.literal: Han has been Han nearly forty years, yet public and private accumulations are still pitiably painful.

units.zh: 民不足而可治者，自古及今，未之嘗聞。
units.en: No regime has stably governed a population in chronic deprivation.
units.literal: That people lacking means can still be governed-from ancient to present, this has never been heard.

units.zh: 古之人曰：「一夫不耕，或受之飢；
units.en: The ancients said, 'If one man does not farm, someone will go hungry;
units.literal: Ancients said: 'If one man does not farm, someone suffers hunger;

units.zh: 一女不織，或受之寒。」
units.en: if one woman does not weave, someone will suffer cold.'
units.literal: if one woman does not weave, someone suffers cold.'

units.zh: 生之有時，而用之亡度，則物力必屈。
units.en: If consumption outruns seasonal production, the economy inevitably buckles.
units.literal: Production has its timing, but use has no measure-then productive force must collapse.

units.zh: 古之治天下，至孅至悉也，故其畜積足恃。
units.en: Classical states built high-resolution management, which is why reserves were dependable.
units.literal: Ancient governance of the realm was meticulous to the finest degree; therefore their stores were sufficient to rely on.

units.zh: 今背本而趨末，食者甚眾，是天下之大殘也；
units.en: When society abandons productive fundamentals for secondary pursuits, macroeconomic damage follows.
units.literal: Now people turn away from root and rush to branch, while consumers are many-this is the realm's great injury;

units.zh: 淫侈之俗，日日以長，是天下之大賊也。
units.en: Escalating luxury culture is treated as parasitic extraction from real production.
units.literal: and luxurious, extravagant custom grows daily-this is the realm's great thief.

units.zh: 殘賊公行，莫之或止；
units.en: Predatory behavior has become normalized and unchecked;
units.literal: Injury and theft run openly, with none to stop them;

units.zh: 大命將泛，莫之振救。
units.en: political legitimacy itself is nearing systemic failure.
units.literal: the great mandate is about to drift, with none to rescue and stabilize it.

units.zh: 生之者甚少而靡之者甚多，天下財產何得不蹶！
units.en: A widening producer-consumer imbalance makes fiscal collapse unavoidable.
units.literal: Those who produce are very few while those who consume are very many-how can the realm's wealth not collapse!

units.zh: 失時不雨，民且狼顧；
units.en: Any weather shock immediately triggers social anxiety and scarcity behavior;
units.literal: If seasonal rain fails, people already look about like wolves;

units.zh: 歲惡不入，請賣爵、子。
units.en: In severe scarcity, people seek desperate liquidity-including status sales and family liquidation.
units.literal: if bad harvest yields no intake, they request selling ranks and even children.

units.zh: 既聞耳矣，安有為天下阽危者若是而上不驚者！
units.en: Given such warning signs, elite complacency is inexcusable.
units.literal: We have already heard this-how can the realm be in such peril and those above not be alarmed!

units.zh: 世之有飢穰，天之行也，禹、湯被之矣。
units.en: Famine and abundance are Heaven's recurrent course; Yu and Tang experienced them too.
units.literal: Ages have famine and abundance-this is Heaven's operation; Yu and Tang experienced it too.

units.zh: 即不幸有方二三千里之旱，國胡以相恤？
units.en: Large-scale drought requires coordinated interregional relief capacity.
units.literal: If by misfortune there is drought over two or three thousand li, how can the state mutually relieve it?

units.zh: 卒然邊境有急，數十百萬之眾，國胡以餽之？
units.en: Likewise, emergency mobilization needs strategic grain depth.
units.literal: If suddenly borders are urgent and crowds of hundreds of thousands arise, how can the state provision them?

units.zh: 兵旱相乘，天下大屈，有勇力者聚徒而衡擊，罷夫羸老易子而沦其骨。
units.en: Compound shocks of war plus famine produce social violence and extreme famine behaviors.
units.literal: When war and drought strike together, the world greatly bends: those with strength gather bands and attack; exhausted elders exchange children and gnaw their bones.

units.zh: 政治未畢通也，遠方之能疑者並舉而爭起矣，乃駭而圖之，豈將有及乎？
units.en: Without integrated governance beforehand, crisis response comes too late.
units.literal: If governance has not yet been fully connected, distant powers still able to doubt will all rise and contend; then to panic and plan, how could there be time?

units.zh: 夫積貯者，天下之大命也。
units.en: Strategic reserves are the state's core survival mechanism.
units.literal: Accumulated storage is the great lifeline of the realm.

units.zh: 苟粟多而財有餘，何為而不成？
units.en: With deep reserves, nearly all strategic aims become feasible.
units.literal: If grain is abundant and wealth in surplus, what objective cannot be accomplished?

units.zh: 以攻則取，以守則固，以戰則勝。
units.en: Reserves convert directly into offensive, defensive, and battlefield advantage.
units.literal: To attack, one takes; to defend, one is firm; to fight, one wins.

units.zh: 懷敵附遠，何招而不至？
units.en: Material strength also enhances diplomacy and long-distance attraction.
units.literal: Holding enemies and attaching distant peoples-what summons would not come?

units.zh: 今毆民而歸之農，皆著於本，使天下各食其力，末技游食之民轉而緣南畝，則畜積足而人樂其所矣。
units.en: Re-agrarianization and labor reallocation toward primary production would stabilize both reserves and social satisfaction.
units.literal: Now if we drive people back to agriculture, all fixed on the root, so everyone eats by labor and roaming eaters of secondary skills turn toward southern furrows, then stores suffice and people enjoy their place.

units.zh: 可以為富安天下，而直為此廩廩也，竊為陛下惜之！
units.en: The policy path to security is available, making current anxiety feel self-inflicted.
units.literal: This could enrich and secure the realm, yet we only remain trembling in fear-I secretly regret this for Your Majesty.

units.zh: 太后既崩，阿母王圣及皇后兄阎显兄弟更秉威权，上遂不亲万机，从容宽仁任臣下。
units.en: When she died, the emperor's wet nurse Wang Sheng and Empress Yan's brothers seized the reins; the ruler withdrew from the daily grind of government, indulged a reputation for mildness, and left policy to his officials.
units.literal: After the empress dowager died, the nurse Wang Sheng and the empress's elder brothers Yan Xian and company in turn grasped awesome power; the emperor thereupon did not personally attend to the myriad threads of state, but was easygoing, lenient, and entrusted things to his ministers.

units.zh: 晏嬰相景公，食不重肉，妾不衣絲，齊國亦治，亦下比於民。
units.en: Yan Ying served Duke Jing on a single meat dish and would not dress his concubines in silk, yet Qi was well governed—he pressed himself down to the people's level.
units.literal: Yan Ying served Duke Jing of Qi; he did not have double portions of meat at meals, his concubines did not wear silk, yet the state of Qi was also well ordered—this was also downward comparison with the people.

units.zh: 為內史數年，遷御史大夫。
units.en: After some years as metropolitan superintendent he rose to imperial counselor.
units.literal: Having been Metropolitan Superintendent for several years, he was promoted to imperial counselor.

units.zh: 建武元年，世祖入洛陽，遣大司馬吳漢等擊檀鄉，明年春，大破降之。
units.en: In Jianwu 1 Emperor Guangwu entered Luoyang and dispatched Grand Marshal Wu Han against the Tanxiang rebels; the following spring the imperial army shattered them and took their surrender.
units.literal: In the first year of Jianwu the Shizu entered Luoyang and sent Grand Marshal Wu Han and others to strike Tanxiang; the next spring they greatly defeated them and accepted their surrender.
